name: tai
description: Terminal AI agent runtime safety and orchestration library: shell-command safety validation, credential redaction, agentic-plan building, and an OpenAI-compatible provider router. Ships the `tai` CLI, a stdio `tai-mcp` server, and the package SDK (main export plus a dedicated ./sdk entry). Stateless: no database, no config store, no server surface.

waivedSurfaces.reason: The tai-mcp stdio server ships in package.json bin, but the kit 0.11.1 class taxonomy admits no truthful declaration for it: class library forbids -mcp bins and class cli-with-store requires a storage block (sqlite/postgresql) while this app has no database of any kind. The mcp surface is therefore waived with its bin undeclared until the app gains a store or the taxonomy gains a config-file store class.
No HTTP server surface ships: package.json declares no -serve bin and no source file starts an HTTP listener.

conformance.notes: storage is deliberately absent. The package persists nothing: no database, no config file, no state directory (verified by source read — no sqlite/postgres import and no writeFile/mkdir in src outside a shell-command safety regex). storage.backend admits sqlite | postgresql only, and neither engine is used.
